title: Data Analysis
description: Analyze a CSV dataset and produce a summary report with charts and key insights.
prompt: Analyze the attached CSV file containing sales data from the past 12 months. Calculate total revenue, average order value, and month-over-month growth. Identify the top 5 products by revenue and the best-performing sales region. Create a line chart for monthly revenue and a bar chart for product rankings. Write a summary report with your findings and recommendations.
